title: Find the Closest Pair of Points
prompt:
Given a collection of points on a plane, implement `closest_pair_distance(points)` to return the smallest Euclidean distance between two different entries. Points may share coordinates, so the answer can be zero. Leave the input unchanged.

There are 2 to 20,000 integer-coordinate points; each coordinate is between -10,000,000 and 10,000,000. Answers within an absolute error of 1e-5 are accepted. Be ready to discuss the time and space costs of your approach.

example.reasoning: The closest two entries are (-7, 1) and (-5, -3).
